findings.text: The repair removes the duplicate fragment correctly, but the only check that the section carries one heading per verification is the uncommitted helper logs/repair-reuse-check.sh in the run's directory (git ls-files finds no copy in the repository), so nothing in the suite fails if a duplicate fragment is added back. A committed test asserting one heading per section would be outside this node's declared write paths, so the node could not add it; recorded here so a coordinator can fold it into a node that owns such a guard.
